name: wake-word
description: Say a wake phrase to open Claude Code, the chat panel, the terminal, or any command. Runs locally, no accounts, zero config.

wakeWord.routes.description: Wake phrase routing table. Each entry maps a spoken phrase to an editor command. If empty, default routes are used (Hey Claude, Hey Chat, Hey Computer).

oneOf.description: A single spoken phrase to listen for (e.g. "hey claude")
Multiple phrases that trigger the same command (e.g. ["hey claude", "open claude"])

phrase.description: Spoken phrase(s) to listen for. Use a string for one phrase or an array for multiple aliases.

cooldownSeconds.description: Override the global cooldown for this route (seconds). Falls back to wakeWord.cooldownSeconds if not set.

confidenceThreshold.description: Override the global trigger threshold for this route (0.01 to 0.9). Lower values detect this route's phrases more easily but increase false positives. Applies to every phrase on the route. Falls back to wakeWord.confidenceThreshold if not set.

handoff.description: How to resume after handing off. 'timer' resumes after cooldownSeconds. 'manual' waits until you click the status bar or run Wake Word: Enable Listening.

wakeWord.cooldownSeconds.description: Seconds to pause wake word listening after handing off to an assistant. Routes with handoff set to 'manual' wait for you instead.

wakeWord.enableOnStartup.description: Start listening automatically when the editor opens.

wakeWord.showNotificationOnDetection.description: Show a brief notification when a wake phrase is detected.

wakeWord.pauseOnFocusLoss.description: Pause wake word listening when the editor loses focus and resume when it regains focus.

wakeWord.confidenceThreshold.description: Trigger threshold (0.01 to 0.9) for wake phrase detection. Lower values detect more easily but increase false positives. Higher values reduce false positives but may miss phrases. The default of 0.05 is tuned for the built-in speech model.

wakeWord.confirmationMode.description: Require the wake phrase to be detected twice within 5 seconds before triggering. Reduces false positives in noisy environments.

wakeWord.audioDevice.description: Microphone to listen on. Leave empty for the system default. Use a case-insensitive substring of the device name (e.g. 'USB' or 'Headset') or the device index number.

scripts.publish:all: npm run publish:vscode && npm run publish:openvsx
scripts.release: npm run compile && npm run package
